plan: [This is the first round, so I have no history to learn from. My value is $13. I want to maximize my profit, which is value - price if I win. In an ascending clock auction, the winning price is the second-highest bid. I should bid lower than my value to ensure a profit if I win. I will bid a fraction of my value to start, to see how the other bidders behave in future rounds. I will bid $6.5, which is half of my value.]
